@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+import logging
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def deliver(notice, transport, repository) -> None:
+    try:
+        transport.send(notice.destination, notice.payload)
+    except OSError:
+        logger.warning("notice transport unavailable", exc_info=True)
+    repository.mark_delivered(notice.id)

pull_request.title: Record delivery attempts for warehouse notices

ground_truth.rationale: An OSError from transport.send is swallowed and execution continues to mark_delivered, so the retry worker will never see a notice that was not sent.
